title: Google Colab MCP Server — Cloud GPU Execution from Any Agent
description: Official open-source MCP server from Google that exposes Colab runtimes to any MCP-compatible agent. Key tools: execute_code (run Python on T4/A100/TPU GPUs), connect (attach to existing session), notebook editing (create/modify .ipynb files), runtime management. First MCP that enables cloud GPU execution directly from a Claude Code session — no local GPU required. Relevant to ML training runs, asset generation pipelines, and image-gen workflows. Official from Google, open-source (googlecolab/colabtools).
redundancy_check: NOVEL — no existing GPU compute or notebook execution MCP in registry. NotebookEdit tool exists for local Jupyter edits but has no compute capability. This adds cloud GPU execution, which is a new capability class.

evaluation.reasoning: Cloud GPU execution is a genuinely novel capability class — the only existing notebook tool (NotebookEdit) is local-only with no compute. Integration requires Google account auth and Colab session setup (70 complexity) but is well-documented from an official Google source. Token efficiency is neutral (50) since this adds compute capability rather than saving context. Capability expansion is high (85): direct applicability to games pipeline ML training, <private-project> image generation workflows, and any future ML workloads. Official Google backing (googlecolab org) = 100 community validation. Main caveats: free tier idle timeouts, auth setup required, and free GPU quota limits.
